dialect.detail: Brazilian IBM mainframe batch program developed by BRQ IT Services, dated November 2014. Uses RECORDING MODE F, BLOCK CONTAINS 0, COMP-3, DECIMAL-POINT IS COMMA (Brazilian locale), and COPY books with naming conventions typical of Brazilian mainframe shops.

purpose.domain_detail: Brazilian bank (likely Bradesco based on 'BRAD7100' and 'I#BRAD7C' copybook references) — processes telephone registration records and installment/due-date records, performing a balance-line match to separate accepted from rejected records.
purpose.summary: Batch balance-line program that reads two sequential input files (ENTRAD1: telephone registration data, ENTRAD2: due/upcoming installment data), matches them by a composite key (bank+agency+account+origin indicator), and writes accepted records to ACEITE and rejected records to DESPZD. Counters track records read and written for each file.

notable_features: Balance-line algorithm with two input files
FILE STATUS checking on all files
REDEFINES used for signed/unsigned key field conversion
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS — pure batch sequential
verdict.notes: Source truncated at 16000 chars; PROCEDURE DIVISION logic is partially visible but the balance-line matching pattern is clear from structure. Program name RDAB0258 and copybook prefix I#BRAD suggest Bradesco (major Brazilian bank). Author and analyst names are Brazilian, consistent with BRQ IT Services, a well-known Brazilian IT outsourcer.
